records: Coinbase's Q3 2026 10-Q does not disclose XRP-specific balances within USD2.804B of unrecognized customer crypto collateral. The recognized derivatives collateral table lists BTC and ETH only, but this does not prove no XRP collateral exists in other Coinbase entities/products. Circle Q2 'USDC on platform' and Coinbase Q3 'average USDC in products' are different definitions and periods. SBI-SMBC approximately 5% equity detail is secondary-reported; official SBI release confirms the alliance but closing not verified. JPYSC public-chain migration, SBI/Startale/BlackRock tokenized-MMF linkage, and Coinbase RLUSD exchange collateral were planned/MOU/future at their cited cutoffs, not live. Arc has a permissioned validator set and Circle stated it had not been reviewed or approved by a regulator at launch.
